referenceFunction.generalComment: The data represent a current toggle type switch, as applied in current information and communication technology (ICT). Material data are taken from product sheets of producers. The energy demand is estimated based on literature. Infrastructure and transport efforts rough estimations. The dataset represents 1 kg of toggle type switches with a weight of 29 gram/unit.; UUID: 15173189-63c6-302e-9c80-fa64a8238f82
